name: RankAI
author: Kunal Parihar

sections.description:
RankAI is a powerful SEO plugin that optimizes your content for both traditional search engines and modern AI tools. Unlike other SEO plugins, RankAI combines classic SEO analysis with a dedicated AI Citation engine — helping your content appear in AI-generated answers, not just Google search results.

What RankAI Does:

  • Analyzes your content in real-time across 14 SEO and AI metrics
  • Automatically injects meta tags, canonical URLs, Open Graph, and Twitter Cards into your page <head>
  • Generates JSON-LD structured data (Article, WebPage, FAQPage schemas) automatically
  • Provides a live Google SERP preview so you can see how your listing will look
  • Scores your E-E-A-T signals (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness)
  • Shows a site-wide SEO health dashboard with per-post score tracking
  • Displays RankAI scores directly in the Posts/Pages list table

Traditional SEO Features:
* SEO Title & Meta Description fields with character counters
* Real-time Google SERP preview
* Keyword density analysis (1-3% optimal range)
* Readability scoring (Flesch-Kincaid)
* Heading structure analysis (H1/H2/H3)
* Sentence length checker
* Internal & external link analysis
* Image alt tag auditing
* Content length scoring

AI Citation Features:
* AI-friendly content structure scoring
* Citation authority analysis (statistics, .edu/.gov/.org links)
* Semantic keyword optimization
* E-E-A-T signals panel with actionable recommendations
* Auto-generated Article and FAQPage JSON-LD schema

Technical SEO (Auto):
* Meta description output in <head>
* Canonical URL output
* Robots meta (noindex/nofollow) per post control
* Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type)
* Twitter Card tags (summary_large_image)
* JSON-LD structured data for Article, WebPage, FAQPage

Dashboard:
* Site-wide SEO health overview (total posts, average score, green/orange/red breakdown)
* Recently analyzed posts table with AI citation and E-E-A-T scores
* Score badges in Posts and Pages list tables
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/rankai/ or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to RankAI in the admin menu to see your dashboard.
  4. Open any post or page and fill in the Focus Keyphrase, SEO Title, and Meta Description fields.
  5. Click Analyze with RankAI to get your score and recommendations.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No. RankAI works entirely on your WordPress server with no external API required.

Will RankAI conflict with Yoast SEO or RankMath?

We recommend using RankAI as a standalone SEO plugin. Running multiple plugins that output meta tags can cause duplicate tags. If migrating from another plugin, deactivate it first.

Does RankAI output meta tags automatically?

Yes. From v1.1.0, RankAI automatically outputs meta description, canonical URL, robots meta, Open Graph, and Twitter Card tags for all singular posts and pages. No configuration needed.

What is the AI Citation score?

The AI Citation score measures how likely your content is to be cited by AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude. It checks for statistics, authority links, schema markup, and E-E-A-T signals.
